propositions: Project-specific code-review criteria configured in criteria_routing.json merge successfully but never execute end-to-end, appearing indistinguishable from a rubric with no issues.
The code-review runtime must dynamically append activated project prompts in Pass 1 (round_a step only), deduplicating against static workflow ids and preserving the versioned workflow schema.
Project prompt and eval assets must resolve from the reviewed repository snapshot; missing or malformed assets raise a fatal LLMError before model execution.

Logical project criterion ids must map to sanitized physical prompt ids (code-review-project-*-with-dashes), with routing computed once per review for deterministic Pass 3 threshold, blocking, and nit-suppression decisions.
The criteria eval CLI must accept activated logical project ids, disambiguate dual-gate ambiguity, and dispatch diff cases through the code-review evaluation path.
